title: Amtrak's corrected car-count ramp series progresses from 110 to 141
summary: Using the reports' corrected number-of-cars table, ramp installations progress from 110 in October 2024 to 120 in April 2025, 129 in October 2025, and 141 in April 2026; the December 2024 narrative's total of 149 remains a documented conflict. Denominator: Four corrected unique-car observations under Amtrak's stated methodology, with the conflicting 149-ramp narrative excluded from the numeric series but preserved in the revision record.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Compatible service time series.
